description: Muse Spark video-understanding output for one uploaded clip: timestamped events, each naming a one-noun SAM concept (and optional box hint) for tracking.

box_hint.description: Optional unverified box hint in 0-1000 relative space {x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max}. Treated as unverified until the spike confirms Spark's coordinate space.

sam_concept.description: ONE short common noun for one SAM 3.1 tracking request.
